data.name: CannotRunHere
data.value: {configuration} cannot run here: {why}
data.comment: A run configuration this machine cannot run, and why.

data.name: CannotRunService
data.value: {configuration} cannot run {service}: {why}
data.comment: A container run configuration whose service this machine's container engine cannot run, and why.

data.name: StoppedStarting
data.value: {name} was stopped as it started
data.comment: A start Stop ended before what it started ran: a program's, a container run's, an AppHost's; {name} is its run configuration.

data.name: StoppedRestarting
data.value: {name}'s restart was stopped
data.comment: A restart of a run's services (Rerun's, a window's Restart, Hot Reload's) that Stop ended; {name} is the run.

data.name: AlreadyRunning
data.value: Already running: {program} has the Run console; stop it first
data.comment: A start that needs the Run console while another program has it; {program} is that program's run configuration.

data.name: AlreadyRunningProgram
data.value: Already running: a program has the Run console; stop it first
data.comment: A start that needs the Run console while a program of no known name has it.

data.name: CopyDidNotStart
data.value: {copy} did not start ({why}); {started} run on
data.comment: A copy of a game that did not start, and why, while the copies started before it run on; {copy} names the copy, {started} lists those running.

data.name: RunsOn
data.value: {name} runs on: nothing was stopped or started
data.comment: A start of a run configuration whose program runs, where the person chose to leave it running.

data.name: StoppedNotStarted
data.value: {name} stopped, not started again
data.comment: A start of a run configuration whose program ran, where the person chose to stop it and not start it again.

data.name: NoGameConfiguration
data.value: {project} has no configuration that runs its game
data.comment: Run Current Scene where the Godot project has no run configuration that runs its game.

data.name: ProfiledHasConsole
data.value: {program}, which Profile started, uses the Run console: Kill it first
data.comment: A start that needs the Run console while a program Profile started has it.

data.name: NoGameToRunAgain
data.value: {name} starts no Godot game, of which Run Another Copy runs one more beside those running
data.comment: Run Another Copy where the chosen run configuration starts no Godot game.

data.name: RunsNoCopy
data.value: Run runs no copy of {name}: Run starts it, then Run Another Copy one more beside it
data.comment: Run Another Copy where Run runs no copy of the chosen configuration's game yet.

data.name: MostCopies
data.value: {most, plural, one {{name} runs # copy, the most one configuration runs} other {{name} runs # copies, the most one configuration runs}}
data.comment: Run or Debug Another Copy where a configuration already runs as many copies of its game as one may.

data.name: WorkingFolderUnmade
data.value: Could not run {program}: its working folder {folder} could not be made: {why}
data.comment: A run with Hot Reload whose program's working folder could not be made, and the system's reason.

data.name: CouldNotRestart
data.value: Hot Reload could not restart {program}: {why}
data.comment: A copy of a game Hot Reload restarts to apply edits it could not apply as it ran, which could not start again, and why.

data.name: AppHostLinkedTwice
data.value: An Aspire configuration cannot link an AppHost more than once
data.comment: An Aspire run configuration that names one AppHost twice among the AppHosts it starts together.

data.name: AppHostAlreadyRunning
data.value: {apphost} is already running in this workspace
data.comment: An Aspire start of an AppHost that runs already, or is starting, in this folder.

data.name: LinkedAppHostUnavailable
data.value: The linked AppHost {file} is not available
data.comment: An Aspire run configuration linking an AppHost the folder has no Aspire configuration of.

data.name: AppHostEndedBeforeProfiling
data.value: The AppHost ended before a service could be profiled
data.comment: Profile of an Aspire run whose AppHost ended before it started the service to profile.

data.name: AppHostEndedBeforeProfiled
data.value: The AppHost ended before {service} could be profiled
data.comment: Profile of an Aspire run whose AppHost ended before the profiler reached the service it started.

data.name: NothingToRestart
data.value: Nothing was launched under the debugger to restart
data.comment: Hot Reload's restart of a debugged program where Debug launched none of that name.

data.name: Debugging
data.value: Debugging {name}
data.comment: What Debug came to once its program runs under the debugger, as an agent's Debug answers; {name} is the run configuration.

data.name: NoGameToDebugAgain
data.value: {name} starts no Godot game, of which Debug Another Copy debugs one more beside those debugged
data.comment: Debug Another Copy where the chosen run configuration starts no Godot game.

data.name: DebugsNoCopy
data.value: No copy of {name} is debugged: Debug starts it, then Debug Another Copy one more beside it
data.comment: Debug Another Copy where no copy of the chosen configuration's game is debugged yet.

data.name: CatalystAppUnbuilt
data.value: Could not debug {name}: its Mac Catalyst app has not been built
data.comment: Debug of a Mac Catalyst app whose build made no app.

data.name: BrowserNotDebugged
data.value: {name}'s components in the browser are not debugged: {why}
data.comment: Debug of a Blazor app whose WebAssembly components could not be debugged in the browser, and why; the app's server is debugged on where it has one.

data.name: NoPackageAppStarted
data.value: Windows started no app of {package}
data.comment: Debug of a Windows app package where Windows started none of the package's apps; {package} is its family name.

data.name: PageCertificateUntrusted
data.value: the development certificate its page {address} is served with is not trusted on this machine, so the browser refuses the page: run dotnet dev-certs https --trust in a terminal, then debug again
data.comment: Why a Blazor app's page cannot be debugged in the browser, after the app's name (BrowserNotDebugged's why); dotnet dev-certs https --trust is a command, kept as written.

data.name: PageCertificateMissing
data.value: its page {address} is served over HTTPS, and this machine has no development certificate: run dotnet dev-certs https --trust in a terminal, then debug again
data.comment: Why a Blazor app's page cannot be debugged in the browser, after the app's name (BrowserNotDebugged's why); dotnet dev-certs https --trust is a command, kept as written.

data.name: NotBuilt
data.value: {verb, select, debug {Could not debug {program}: {file} has not been built} profile {Could not profile {program}: {file} has not been built} other {Could not run {program}: {file} has not been built}}
data.comment: Run, Debug or Profile ({verb}: run, debug, profile) of a program whose build has not made the file it starts.

data.name: CouldNot
data.value: {verb, select, debug {Could not debug {program}: {why}} profile {Could not profile {program}: {why}} other {Could not run {program}: {why}}}
data.comment: Run, Debug or Profile ({verb}: run, debug, profile) of a program that cannot start here, and why.

data.name: NoWorkingFolder
data.value: {verb, select, debug {Could not debug {program}: its working folder {folder} does not exist} profile {Could not profile {program}: its working folder {folder} does not exist} other {Could not run {program}: its working folder {folder} does not exist}}
data.comment: Run, Debug or Profile ({verb}: run, debug, profile) of a program whose working folder is gone.

data.name: ProjectNotLoaded
data.value: {name} cannot run: its project {file} is not loaded in the open folder
data.comment: A run configuration whose project the open folder has not loaded.

data.name: BuildsUnknown
data.value: MSBuild could not say what {project} builds
data.comment: A start whose project MSBuild named no built file for.

data.name: BuildsUnknownBecause
data.value: MSBuild could not say what {project} builds: {why}
data.comment: A start whose project MSBuild could not evaluate, and why.

data.name: GodotRunsOnly
data.value: {name} cannot run: Godot loads a game's {configuration} build alone, where the build configuration chosen builds {project} as {built} (as an export does): choose {configuration} to run it
data.comment: A Godot game whose project the chosen build configuration builds otherwise than the one Godot loads ({configuration}, such as Debug).

data.name: InContainers
data.value: {name} runs in containers, which Run, Debug and Profile bring up: it starts no program on this computer
data.comment: Why a container run configuration has no program of this machine's to plan: Run, Debug and Profile bring its containers up.

data.name: SeveralProjects
data.value: {name} starts several projects, each as its own configuration starts it: Run and Debug start them together, and Profile records one program, which one of their configurations starts
data.comment: Why a run configuration of several projects has no one program: Profile records one, which a project's own configuration starts.

data.name: CannotRun
data.value: {name} cannot run: {why}
data.comment: A run configuration that cannot run, and why (the container engine's state, a reason of the system's).

data.name: CannotBuildAs
data.value: {name} cannot build as {build}: {why}
data.comment: A run configuration naming a build configuration ({build}, such as Release|x64) its folder cannot give, and why.

data.name: RunsNoContainers
data.value: {name} runs no containers
data.comment: A container start (a run icon's) of a run configuration that is no container configuration.

data.name: NoDockerfile
data.value: {name} cannot run: {project} has no Dockerfile
data.comment: A Dockerfile run configuration whose project has no Dockerfile.

data.name: NoDotnetService
data.value: {verb, select, debug {Nothing to debug: {name} starts no .NET service} other {Nothing to profile: {name} starts no .NET service}}
data.comment: Debug or Profile ({verb}: debug, profile) of a container run configuration none of whose services is .NET.

data.name: ServiceNotBuilt
data.value: Could not run {name}: {file} has not been built in {folder}
data.comment: A container run whose .NET service's assembly ({file}) its build did not make in its output folder.

data.name: OverrideUnwritten
data.value: {name} cannot run: Passenger's override could not be written: {why}
data.comment: A container run whose Compose override file, which Passenger writes for its run, could not be written, and the system's reason.

data.name: DidNotComeUp
data.value: {name} did not come up: {said}
data.comment: A container run whose docker compose up failed, with the last words it said.

data.name: WouldReplace
data.value: {name} was not run: it would replace {containers} of {project}, which Passenger did not make for this folder, and {why}; remove them first, or run it from the window
data.comment: A container run that would replace containers of its Compose project ({project}) Passenger did not make, where nobody can be asked ({why}, NobodyToAsk or AgentStartedRun).

data.name: LeftAsTheyAre
data.value: {name} was not run: {containers} of {project}, which Passenger did not make for this folder, were left as they are
data.comment: A container run the person chose not to run rather than replace containers of its Compose project ({project}) Passenger did not make.

data.name: AgentStartedRun
data.value: an agent's call started this run, and asks no one
data.comment: Why nobody is asked about a run (after “and” in WouldReplace and OverHttpUnasked): an agent started it.

data.name: NobodyToAsk
data.value: nobody is at this IDE to ask (an agent's own)
data.comment: Why nobody is asked about a run (after “and” in WouldReplace and OverHttpUnasked): this Passenger is an agent's, with no person at it.

data.name: CheckingCertificate
data.value: Checking the HTTPS development certificate…
data.comment: A run's stage, in the status bar, while dotnet dev-certs checks the HTTPS development certificate.

data.name: TrustingCertificate
data.value: Making and trusting the HTTPS development certificate…
data.comment: A run's stage, in the status bar, while dotnet dev-certs makes and trusts the HTTPS development certificate.

data.name: ExportingCertificate
data.value: Exporting the HTTPS development certificate…
data.comment: A run's stage, in the status bar, while dotnet dev-certs exports the HTTPS development certificate for its containers.

data.name: OverHttpUnasked
data.value: {services} over HTTP for this run: {standing, select, missing {the development certificate is not there} other {the development certificate is not trusted}}, and {why}
data.comment: What serves HTTPS ({services}) served over HTTP for this run, the certificate missing or not trusted ({standing}), where nobody could be asked ({why}).

data.name: OverHttpChosen
data.value: {services} over HTTP for this run: {standing, select, missing {the development certificate is not there} other {the development certificate is not trusted}}
data.comment: What serves HTTPS ({services}) served over HTTP for this run, the person having chosen not to make or trust the missing or untrusted certificate ({standing}).

data.name: OverHttp
data.value: {services} over HTTP for this run: {why}
data.comment: What serves HTTPS ({services}) served over HTTP for this run, as a step of dev-certs failed ({why}).

data.name: ServesHttp
data.value: {count, plural, one {{services} serves HTTP for this run: {why}} other {{services} serve HTTP for this run: {why}}}
data.comment: The run's console line for what serves HTTPS ({services}, {count} of them) served over HTTP for this run, as a step of dev-certs failed ({why}).

data.name: CertificateNotTrusted
data.value: the development certificate was not trusted: {said}
data.comment: Why a run serves HTTP (OverHttp's why): dotnet dev-certs did not trust the certificate, with what it said.

data.name: CertificateNotExported
data.value: the development certificate could not be exported: {said}
data.comment: Why a container run serves HTTP (OverHttp's why): dotnet dev-certs did not export the certificate, with what it said.

data.name: StillComingUp
data.value: {name} is still coming up
data.comment: Detach of a container run whose services are still coming up.

data.name: ProfilerRecords
data.value: The profiler records {service} of {name}: Stop ends the recording, and Detach lets go of a run nothing records
data.comment: Detach of a container run one of whose services the profiler records.

data.name: NoContainerRunUnderWay
data.value: No container run is under way
data.comment: A Containers window action on the run's own Compose project where no container run is under way.

data.name: NoContainerRun
data.value: No container run is under way: Run, Debug or Profile a container configuration first
data.comment: A service action, or Detach, where no container run is under way.

data.name: CouldNotAttach
data.value: {verb, select, profile {Could not profile {service}: {why}} other {Could not debug {service}: {why}}}
data.comment: A service of a run (container or Aspire) the debugger or the profiler ({verb}: debug, profile) could not reach, and why.

data.name: RunsWithout
data.value: {tool, select, profiler {{service} runs without the profiler: {why}} other {{service} runs without the debugger: {why}}}
data.comment: A service held for the debugger or the profiler ({tool}: debugger, profiler) that runs on without it, and why.

data.name: ProfilerUnavailable
data.value: The profiler is not available
data.comment: Profile of a service where this window has no profiler to record it.

data.name: WithCaveat
data.value: {why} ({caveat})
data.comment: Why a service could not be debugged, with what its kind says of such a service after it.

data.name: NoBrowserDebugs
data.value: no browser debugs them
data.comment: Why a Blazor app's components in the browser are not debugged (BrowserNotDebugged's why): no browser that debugs them was found.

data.name: RestartedUnheld
data.value: {why}; {services} restarted to run without the debugger
data.comment: Services restarted held for a debugger that could not attach ({why}), restarted again unheld.

data.name: NotRestartedUnheld
data.value: {why}; {services} could not be restarted to run without it: {said}
data.comment: Services restarted held for a debugger that could not attach ({why}), which could not be restarted again unheld, and why.

data.name: ServicesNotRestarted
data.value: {services} of {run} could not be restarted: {why}
data.comment: A restart of services of a run that its kind refused (a command refused, a time limit), and why.

data.name: NoServiceChosen
data.value: No .NET service of {run} is chosen
data.comment: A service action where no service of the run is chosen.

data.name: ServiceOfNoProject
data.value: {service} is not a .NET service of {run}: no project of the solution is known to run it; choose its project in a copy of {run} (Run > Edit Configurations)
data.comment: A service action on a compose service no project of the solution is known to run; Run > Edit Configurations is the menu's path.

data.name: NotDotnetService
data.value: {service} is not a .NET service of {run}
data.comment: A service action on a service of the run that is no .NET service.

data.name: DoesNotStart
data.value: {run} does not start {service}
data.comment: A service action on a service its run does not start.

data.name: RestartedUnrecorded
data.value: {why}; {services} restarted to run without the profiler
data.comment: A service started held for the profiler, which could not record it ({why}), restarted again unheld.

data.name: NotAttached
data.value: {service} could not be attached to
data.comment: Attach to a service of a run where the debugger did not attach and said nothing of why.

data.name: ServiceActing
data.value: {action, select, debug {Restarting {service} to debug it…} attach {Attaching the debugger to {service}…} run {Running {service} without the debugger…} restart {Restarting {service}…} other {Attaching the profiler to {service}…}}
data.comment: A service action's stage in the status bar ({action}: debug, attach, run without the debugger, restart, profile).

data.name: ServiceActionStopped
data.value: {action, select, debug {Restarting {service} to debug it was stopped} attach {Attaching the debugger to {service} was stopped} run {Running {service} without the debugger was stopped} restart {Restarting {service} was stopped} other {Attaching the profiler to {service} was stopped}}
data.comment: A service action ({action}: debug, attach, run without the debugger, restart, profile) that Stop ended.

data.name: ServiceActionFailed
data.value: {action, select, debug {Restarting {service} to debug it failed: {why}} attach {Attaching the debugger to {service} failed: {why}} run {Running {service} without the debugger failed: {why}} restart {Restarting {service} failed: {why}} other {Attaching the profiler to {service} failed: {why}}}
data.comment: A service action ({action}: debug, attach, run without the debugger, restart, profile) its run refused, and why.

data.name: CannotDebugHere
data.value: {configuration} cannot debug here: {why}
data.comment: Debug of a run configuration of several parts this machine cannot debug, and why.

data.name: CannotStartPart
data.value: {configuration} cannot start {part}: {why}
data.comment: A run configuration of several parts one of whose parts ({part}) cannot start, and why.

data.name: GameStartsApart
data.value: a Godot game starts from its own configuration, which follows its scenes and copies
data.comment: Why a part of a run configuration of several parts cannot start (CannotStartPart's why): it is a Godot game.

data.name: DeviceAppStartsApart
data.value: an app on a device starts from its own configuration, which installs it there
data.comment: Why a part of a run configuration of several parts cannot start (CannotStartPart's why): it runs on a device.

data.name: CatalystAppStartsApart
data.value: a Mac Catalyst app starts from its own configuration, which has the system open it
data.comment: Why a part of a run configuration of several parts cannot start (CannotStartPart's why): it is a Mac Catalyst app.

data.name: PackageStartsApart
data.value: a packaged Windows app starts from its own configuration, which registers it with Windows
data.comment: Why a part of a run configuration of several parts cannot start (CannotStartPart's why): it is a Windows app package.

data.name: PartDidNotStart
data.value: {count, plural, one {{part} did not start ({why}); {started} runs on} other {{part} did not start ({why}); {started} run on}}
data.comment: A part of a run configuration of several parts that did not start, and why, the parts started before it ({started}, {count} of them) running on.

data.name: NamesNoCommand
data.value: it names no command to run
data.comment: Why a command part of a run configuration cannot start (CannotStartPart's why).

data.name: FolderGone
data.value: its folder {folder} is gone
data.comment: Why a command part of a run configuration cannot start (CannotStartPart's why): the folder it runs in is gone.

data.name: ProgramNotFound
data.value: {program} was not found
data.comment: Why a command part of a run configuration cannot start (CannotStartPart's why): the program it names by a path is not there.

data.name: ProgramNotOnPath
data.value: {program} was not found on the PATH
data.comment: Why a command part of a run configuration cannot start (CannotStartPart's why): the program it names is on no folder of the PATH.

data.name: PackageUnread
data.value: {file} is gone, or does not read as a package.json
data.comment: Why a Node.js part of a run configuration cannot start (CannotStartPart's why): its package.json is gone or unreadable.

data.name: NoScriptNamed
data.value: {package}'s package.json has no script named {script}
data.comment: Why a Node.js script part of a run configuration cannot start (CannotStartPart's why).

data.name: PartNotRestarted
data.value: {part} could not restart: {why}
data.comment: A part of a run of several parts, restarted from its tab in the Run window, that could not start again, and why; written in its console.

data.name: ReadingPackage
data.value: Reading {name}'s package.json…
data.comment: A start's stage, in the status bar, while it reads a Node.js package's package.json.

data.name: RunningScript
data.value: Running {name}: {command} in {folder}
data.comment: What Run says once a Node.js script runs: the command its package manager runs, and the folder it runs in.

data.name: DebugEndedAsStarted
data.value: Debugging {name} ended as it started
data.comment: Debug of an app on a device, or a Mac Catalyst app, whose session ended as it started, saying nothing of why.

data.name: PuttingDebuggerIn
data.value: Putting Passenger's debugger in {app}…
data.comment: A start's stage, in the status bar, while Passenger's debugger goes into an app on a device, or a Mac Catalyst app ({app}, its package).

data.name: StartingOnDevice
data.value: {where, select, mac {Starting {name} on this Mac under the debugger…} other {Starting {name} on its device under the debugger…}}
data.comment: A start's stage, in the status bar, as an app starts under the debugger on its device, or on this Mac for a Mac Catalyst app ({where}: device, mac).

data.name: DeviceStartFailed
data.value: {name} could not be started on its device: {why}
data.comment: Debug of an app on a device whose start command could not run, and the system's reason.

data.name: ChoosingAspireService
data.value: An Aspire service is already being chosen
data.comment: Profile of an Aspire run while the question of which of its services to profile is open already.

data.name: NoAspireResourceChosen
data.value: No Aspire project resource is selected
data.comment: A run icon's Run, Debug or Profile of an AppHost's resource where none is chosen.

data.name: AppHostSourceChanged
data.value: The AppHost source changed; open its gutter action again
data.comment: A run icon's action on an AppHost's resource whose source changed since its menu opened.

data.name: AppHostResourceChanged
data.value: The selected AppHost resource changed
data.comment: A run icon's action on an AppHost's resource that changed since its menu opened.

data.name: PlaysNoGodotGame
data.value: {name} plays no Godot game
data.comment: A run configuration that plays in Godot's editor whose project is no Godot game's.

data.name: PlaysInPersonsEditor
data.value: {name} plays in the person's own Godot editor, which an agent's own Passenger does not ask: choose a configuration that runs the game here
data.comment: An agent's own Passenger asked to play a game in the person's Godot editor, which it never asks.

data.name: NoSceneOpen
data.value: {name} cannot run: it starts in the scene open in the editor, and none is (a .tscn, or a script a scene's node runs)
data.comment: A Godot run configuration that starts in the scene open in the editor, where none is open.

data.name: PlayNotTaken
data.value: Godot's editor on {project} did not take the play within {within}
data.comment: Godot's editor, asked through Passenger's addon to play, that did not take the play in time ({within}, a while said).

data.name: PlaysThroughAddon
data.value: {how, select, debugged {{project} plays in Godot's editor, built here and debugged by this Passenger} other {{project} plays in Godot's editor, built here}}
data.comment: A game playing in Godot's editor through Passenger's addon, debugged or not ({how}: debugged, run).

data.name: PlaysMainSceneOnly
data.value: {older, select, older {Godot's editor on {project} plays only its main scene when asked without Passenger's addon: Install Passenger's Godot Addon… to play the scene chosen; Passenger's addon there is too old to play as asked, so Install Passenger's Godot Addon… updates it} other {Godot's editor on {project} plays only its main scene when asked without Passenger's addon: Install Passenger's Godot Addon… to play the scene chosen}}
data.comment: A scene asked to play in Godot's editor without Passenger's addon there, or with an older one ({older}: older, none); Install Passenger's Godot Addon… is a menu item.

data.name: EditorRefusedPlay
data.value: Godot's editor on {project} {said}
data.comment: Godot's editor refusing a play asked through its IDE messaging, with what it said after its project's name.

data.name: PlaysThroughMessaging
data.value: {how, select, debugged {{older, select, older {{project} plays in Godot's editor undebugged: Godot's IDE messaging gives no debugger a way in, and Passenger's addon does (Install Passenger's Godot Addon…); Passenger's addon there is too old to play as asked, so Install Passenger's Godot Addon… updates it} other {{project} plays in Godot's editor undebugged: Godot's IDE messaging gives no debugger a way in, and Passenger's addon does (Install Passenger's Godot Addon…)}}} other {{older, select, older {{project} plays in Godot's editor, built here; Passenger's addon there is too old to play as asked, so Install Passenger's Godot Addon… updates it} other {{project} plays in Godot's editor, built here}}}}
data.comment: A game playing in Godot's editor through its IDE messaging, without Passenger's addon there or with an older one ({older}: older, none), debugged or not ({how}: debugged, run).

data.name: GodotEditorNotOpen
data.value: Godot's editor is not open on {project}: open it, then run {name} again
data.comment: A play in Godot's editor where it is not open on the project, and no configuration opens it.

data.name: GodotEditorNotOpenOpens
data.value: Godot's editor is not open on {project}: {editor} opens it, then run {name} again
data.comment: A play in Godot's editor where it is not open on the project; {editor} is the run configuration that opens it.

data.name: OpenGodotEditorTitle
data.value: Open Godot's Editor?
data.comment: The title of the question asked where a play in Godot's editor finds it not open.

data.name: OpenGodotEditorQuestion
data.value: Godot's editor is not open on {project}, so it cannot play {name}. Open it now, then run {name} again once it is up.
data.comment: The question asked where a play in Godot's editor finds it not open.

data.name: OpenInGodotEditor
data.value: Open in Godot Editor
data.comment: The button of the question asked where a play in Godot's editor finds it not open, which opens it.

data.name: GodotEditorOpens
data.value: Godot's editor opens on {project}: run {name} again once it is up
data.comment: Godot's editor opening on the project after the person chose to open it for a play.

data.name: GodotEditorNotOpened
data.value: Godot's editor could not open on {project}: {why}
data.comment: Godot's editor, which the person chose to open for a play, that could not open, and why.
